title: Add Mumei native run testing skill
body:
Adds a reusable testing skill for Mumei native run/binary pipeline changes. The skill captures the local prerequisites, secrets needed, adversarial CLI commands, and concrete expected statuses for native execution and Rust FFI runtime linking.

Devin Session: https://app.devin.ai/sessions/0ac820dd563043c7abdaed74a2d46a90
